## sub_42D210_0042d210 — PauseStateDisplayToggle

**Summary:** Sets pause state flag on object. When unpausing (a2=0), copies "Paused" string into message buffer and triggers screen update via ShortComputation_bde0.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** DispatchChainWithVTableCalls (0046da20), sub_46DC60 (0046dc60), sub_4A00A0 (004a00a0), sub_4A0250 (004a0250), sub_4A0490 (004a0490), sub_4A0A80 (004a0a80), sub_4B9890 (004b9890), VidMan_Restart (004fa640), sub_4FA7E0 (004fa7e0)

|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x10 | RW | — | Pause flag (0=unpaused, nonzero=paused); written unconditionally |
